title: Payload Helper
content_data:
> **Note**
> For detailed instructions on using the Payload Helper, you refer to our comprehensive user guides for **web** or **app** events. These guides provide step-by-step information to help you efficiently create and manage your payloads and are available at the following links:

> - [Work with Payload Helper for Web](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1807346079965186) > - [Work with Payload Helper for App](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1819581869993025)
seo_title: Events API Payload Helper | TikTok API for Business
seo_description: The Payload Helper is a user interface provided by TikTok API for Business to simplify the process of creating payloads for the Events API 2.0.
